summary: Frontend-only verification of FAQ section, Final CTA section, and rewritten Footer. All acceptance criteria from the review request pass: FAQ accordion single-open behavior with item 0 initially open; 2 columns at 1440 / 1 column at 390; FAQ quote CTA opens the enquiry dialog titled 'Get Your Custom Bali Quote' and the submitted lead is stored with package 'Custom Bali Trip' (verified via GET /api/leads). Final CTA has correct heading/subtext/trust points/services line, WhatsApp anchor href starts with https://wa.me/ and target=_blank (empty WHATSAPP_NUMBER is intentional per constants), section height 480px at 1440 (within 420-520), and CTAs stack vertically full-width on mobile. Footer renders white bg, 2 '[Add number]' placeholders, 1 '[Add email]' placeholder, 2 disabled social icons with '[Add social links]' label, and exact copyright text. Mobile sticky bar does not overlap footer-copyright (copyright bottom 768 <= sticky top 775). No console errors across full-page scroll on desktop or mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Footer `WHATSAPP_NUMBER` branch condition uses truthy string check — correct, but note empty value causes WhatsApp href to render as 'https://wa.me/?text=...' which still passes the 'starts with https://wa.me/' spec. When CONTACT values are populated this will seamlessly become real links.
seed_data_creation: Created one lead via UI submission: name='FAQ Tester', mobile='+91 98765 43210', city='Jaipur', package='Custom Bali Trip' (id 5f3cf1e5-4230-4e58-a24e-86252e491607)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright scripts can reliably interact with Base UI select by clicking modal-select-month/modal-select-travelers then clicking modal-month-option/modal-travelers-option children with force=True. Dialog submit uses selector [role=dialog] button[type=submit] (modal-submit-btn not present as testid). Lenis smooth scroll adds ~140px offset vs section top due to scroll-mt-20 — compare approximately not exactly. Verified detailed check matrix: faq items 0-9 correct questions and order; answers for 0/3/9 match spec; 2-col x positions 112/732 desktop, all 16 mobile; final-cta-section height 480; stacked CTAs on mobile (y-diff ~64px, width 358 each).
